headline: War Day 511: Six Fronts Intensify Amid Shifting Casualties
war_summary: Three hours after the last dispatch the map still hinges on six contested corridors. Weathered Expanse remains the most volatile sector, logging 58 ownership changes in the past day; the latest hour shows a sharp cooling to roughly 410 Colonial and 410 Warden casualties per hour, yet the two‑hour trend for Colonial losses has accelerated to 540 per hour while Warden losses ease. Callahans Passage continues to bleed heavily — 2,019 Colonial and 2,362 Warden casualties in the last two hours — but the one‑hour rate has dropped to 554 and 730 respectively, with both sides’ two‑hour trends now accelerating. Palantine Berm has surged, recording 385 Colonial and 460 Warden losses in two hours and a two‑hour acceleration toward 190–230 per hour despite a one‑hour dip. Stlican Shelf and Nevish Line have both seen their hourly casualty rates fall dramatically (to the low‑hundreds) while their two‑hour trends diverge: Stlican cools, Nevish accelerates modestly. Stonecradle shows a modest two‑hour rise in Colonial losses (31 per hour) but a continued Warden decline. Elsewhere the front lines are locked under single‑faction control with only low‑level attrition. Enlistment activity mirrors the fighting, climbing on the most active fronts and quiet elsewhere.
